projects.title: Dossier Made
projects.description: A custom built website that is designed to host cinematography created by Elijah Cutler and myself. The website is build with React as a frontend and Firebase as the backend. The website offers user and content management to easily allow for new work to be created and managed in a manner similar to a CMS.

projects.title: Rap Me A Recipe
projects.description: Rap Me A Recipe was an entry to HackUMBC 2017. My group, consisting of Brian Huang, Chris Mills, and myself, built an Amazon Alexa Skill that uses the McCormick API to create a rap of a recipe's description, then play it back to you. This is done by first finding a recipe based on a food that a user asks an Alexa. Then,  once a recipe is found, the description is used along with the MusixMatch API to find songs with lyrics that contain words from the description. One song is used per word in the description. With a list of songs, the timestamp where the lyrics and be heard is then obtained through the YouTube API. This is done by looking at a songs video that contains subtitles with timestamps. However, these timestamps only pertain to lines of lyrics rather than each word, so we calculated where a word would fall in that range of time. Now with the list of songs with included timestamps, we used the Spotify API to play back each song at the specific point where the word is. This being the rap that will of the searched recipe.
